Fortunately, there is a solution that allows you to automate ebook delivery after [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you-2|crypto]] payment, ensuring you retain full ownership of your products and processes.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment is a straightforward process that combines cryptocurrency payment verification with seamless product delivery. Instead of relying on platforms like Gumroad, which charge fees as high as 10% per transaction, you can use tools such as NOWPayments, which only take 0.5%. This difference can significantly impact your earnings, especially if you have high sales volume. For instance, with 100 sales of a $97 ebook, the fee difference retains an additional $921 in your pocket. This approach not only maximizes your revenue but also enables you to maintain total control over your digital store.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture for automated ebook delivery consists of several integrated components that work together to create a seamless experience. You’ll use free hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your website, where you can display your offerings. For backend processing, services like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage payment logic and order fulfillment. Once a payment is verified through NOWPayments, automated scripts deliver the ebook to the buyer instantly. This architecture ensures that you are not dependent on any external platform, and all your data remains yours, empowering you with true sovereignty over your digital commerce.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This automated delivery system is specifically designed for digital creators who are often sidelined by payment processing giants. Whether you’re selling ebooks, courses, or digital templates, this solution gives you the tools needed to thrive in restrictive environments. Creators in Nigeria, Kenya, and similar regions can now reach global audiences without the burden of high fees and payment limitations. With this architecture, you can directly engage with your customers and ensure a frictionless buying experience, enhancing your ability to monetize your digital creations effectively.
Automate your ebook delivery for seamless transactions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of automated ebook delivery lies in its combination of various free and open-source tools. Key components include a hosting service like GitHub Pages for your storefront, a backend logic service like Google Apps Script for handling payment processing, and NOWPayments to manage cryptocurrency transactions. Each component plays a critical role; for example, GitHub Pages hosts your content, while NOWPayments ensures secure and swift payment verification. This modular approach not only reduces costs but also allows for scalability, enabling you to grow your digital store without worrying about platform restrictions or excessive fees.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To begin deploying your automated ebook delivery system, start by setting up your GitHub Pages site, where you will showcase your products. Next, integrate Google Apps Script to manage backend processes, including order confirmations and product delivery. After establishing your website and backend, connect NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. Ensure that your product files are stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for easy access and delivery. Finally, test the entire flow to ensure that payments and delivery work seamlessly, giving your customers a smooth purchasing experience.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can set up an automated delivery system using cryptocurrency payments. Integrate platforms like GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing. This method allows you to retain full control and avoid high platform fees.
Retain full ownership of your digital products and processes.

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution that combines all these elements, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates essential for building and scaling your sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore your options.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

The best way to sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees is to use a combination of free hosting, automated scripts for order processing, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This approach minimizes costs and maximizes your income.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by leveraging your own infrastructure, using tools like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments for payment processing. This allows you to avoid fees typically associated with platforms like Gumroad.
What are some low-fee cryptocurrency options for transactions?

Recommended networks for low-fee transactions include Binance Smart Chain (BSC), Solana, and TRON, which typically charge under $0.10 per transaction. These options help keep your payment costs minimal.
How can I ensure my customers receive their products immediately?

By using automated scripts through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can ensure that product delivery happens instantly upon payment confirmation, enhancing customer satisfaction and trust.
